title: Installation of lighting and light-signalling devices for L3 vehicles (version 4.0.0)
scope_summary: Approves vehicle types with regard to the installation of their lighting and light-signalling devices, covering the number, position, geometric visibility, colour, alignment and electrical connection of lamps. It applies only to vehicles of category L3 (two-wheeled motorcycles).
scope_quote: This Regulation applies to vehicles of category L3 with regard to the installation of lighting and light-signalling devices.
applies_to_components: Grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps
Lamps equipped with LED substitute light sources
relation_to_other_regulations: Uses the definitions in the latest series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 48 unless otherwise specified, including the definitions of light colour, axis of reference, centre of reference and rear registration plate lamp.
Refers to UN Regulation No. 97: direction indicator lamps may also be used according to its provisions (vehicle alarm systems).
Refers to UN Regulation No. 149: an ADB must be type-approved under R149, and the R149 provisions for the driving-beam function of AFS apply to ADB.
Requires lamps approved under one of the Regulations annexed to the 1958 Agreement (the device regulations) or lamps allowed in the country of registration.
Allows the approval mark to be combined with the marks of other Regulations under which the vehicle is approved (para. 4.5).
Approval numbers currently use the 03 series of amendments; transitional provisions apply for the 04 series of amendments (para. 11.12).

defined_terms.label: Lamp
defined_terms.definition: A device designed to illuminate the road or to emit a light signal to other road users, including rear registration plate lamps and retro-reflectors.

defined_terms.label: Equivalent lamps
defined_terms.definition: Lamps having the same function and authorised in the country of registration, which may differ from the lamps fitted at approval provided they satisfy this Regulation.

defined_terms.label: Independent lamp
defined_terms.definition: Devices having separate apparent surfaces, separate light sources and separate lamp bodies.

defined_terms.label: Grouped lamps
defined_terms.definition: Devices having separate apparent surfaces and separate light sources but a common lamp body.

defined_terms.label: Combined
defined_terms.definition: Devices having separate apparent surfaces but a common light source and a common lamp body.

defined_terms.label: Reciprocally incorporated
defined_terms.definition: Devices having separate light sources, or a single light source operating under different conditions, with totally or partially common apparent surfaces and a common lamp body.

defined_terms.label: Direction indicator lamp
defined_terms.definition: The lamp used to indicate to other road users that the driver intends to change direction to the right or left, which may also be used according to UN R97.

defined_terms.label: Front position lamp
defined_terms.definition: The lamp used to indicate the presence of the vehicle when viewed from the front.

defined_terms.label: Rear position lamp
defined_terms.definition: The lamp used to indicate the presence of the vehicle when viewed from the rear.

defined_terms.label: Retro-reflector
defined_terms.definition: A device indicating the presence of a vehicle by reflecting light from a source not connected to the vehicle, excluding retro-reflecting number plates.

defined_terms.label: Light-emitting surface
defined_terms.definition: All or part of the exterior surface of the transparent material of a lighting device, light-signalling device or retro-reflector, as declared by the manufacturer on the drawing.

defined_terms.label: Illuminating surface of a lighting device
defined_terms.definition: For driving-beam and passing-beam headlamps and front fog lamps, the orthogonal projection of the full aperture of the reflector (or projection lens) on a transverse plane.

defined_terms.label: Illuminating surface of a light-signalling device other than a retro-reflector
defined_terms.definition: The orthogonal projection of the lamp in a plane perpendicular to its axis of reference, bounded by screens each allowing 98 per cent of the luminous intensity to persist.

defined_terms.label: Illuminating surface of a retro-reflector
defined_terms.definition: The orthogonal projection of a retro-reflector in a plane perpendicular to its axis of reference, delimited by the outermost parts of its optical system.

defined_terms.label: Apparent surface
defined_terms.definition: For a defined direction of observation, the orthogonal projection of either the illuminating surface boundary or the light-emitting surface onto a plane perpendicular to that direction.

defined_terms.label: Centre of reference
defined_terms.definition: The intersection of the axis of reference with the exterior light-emitting surface, as specified by the lamp manufacturer.

defined_terms.label: Extreme outer edge
defined_terms.definition: The plane parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane touching its lateral extremity, disregarding projections of mirrors, direction indicators, position lamps and retro-reflectors.

defined_terms.label: Over-all width
defined_terms.definition: The distance between the two vertical planes defining the extreme outer edges.

defined_terms.label: Horizontal inclination
defined_terms.definition: The angle between the beam pattern of the motorcycle set upright as specified in para. 5.4 and the beam pattern when the motorcycle is banked.

defined_terms.label: Horizontal inclination adjustment system (HIAS)
defined_terms.definition: A device that adjusts the horizontal inclination of the headlamp towards zero.

defined_terms.label: Bank angle
defined_terms.definition: The angle with the vertical made by the motorcycle's vertical longitudinal median plane when it is rotated about its longitudinal axis.

defined_terms.label: HIAS signal
defined_terms.definition: Any control signal or additional control input to the HIAS, or any control output from it to the motorcycle.

defined_terms.label: HIAS signal generator
defined_terms.definition: A device reproducing one or more HIAS signals for system testing.

defined_terms.label: HIAS test angle
defined_terms.definition: The angle δ between the headlamp cut-off line and the HH line.

defined_terms.label: Device
defined_terms.definition: A component or combination of components used to perform one or several functions.

defined_terms.label: Exterior courtesy lamp
defined_terms.definition: A lamp providing supplementary illumination to assist the driver and passenger in mounting and dismounting, or to assist in loading operations.

defined_terms.label: Adaptive Driving-Beam (ADB)
defined_terms.definition: A front lighting system consisting of driving-beam(s) only, type-approved to UN R149, that adapts its beam pattern to oncoming and preceding vehicles without causing glare.

defined_terms.label: ADB neutral state
defined_terms.definition: The state of the ADB when the driving-beam is in the maximum condition of activation.

defined_terms.label: Rear-end collision alert signal (RECAS)
defined_terms.definition: An automatic signal given by the leading vehicle warning the following vehicle that it needs to take emergency action to avoid a collision.

applicability_hints: The regulation approves the vehicle, not individual lamps; any lamp, retro-reflector or signalling device fitted to an L3 motorcycle must be installed to meet its position, visibility, colour and switching rules, while the device itself is approved under its own device regulation.
Retro-reflectors and rear registration plate lamps count as lamps; retro-reflecting number plates do not.
Lamp assemblies that integrate several functions (grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated) are subject to para. 5.6.

Electronic control units or sensors that trigger signals fall within scope through the functions they control, such as ECUs for the emergency stop signal or RECAS, automatic headlamp switching (Annex 8), automatic driving-beam/ADB control (Annex 9), and HIAS bank-angle sensors and controllers.
Cornering or banking headlamp systems and their bend-lighting units are relevant through the HIAS and passing-beam provisions.
Dashboard tell-tales indicating lighting functions are covered by para. 5.12.
Direction indicators used by an alarm system (R97) remain subject to this regulation.
The ADB must also be type-approved under UN R149.
Lamps using LED substitute light sources require a manufacturer statement at application (para. 3.2.6).
Applies only to category L3; other L categories (mopeds, tricycles, quadricycles) are not in scope.
